ISO_IEC_42005:Clause 5.2.title: Documenting the process
ISO_IEC_42005:Clause 5.2.note: The organisation has a written AI system impact assessment process that people can find, follow and keep current.

ISO_IEC_42005:Clause 5.3.note: The impact assessment process is wired into the organisation's existing risk, management-system and governance routines rather than running alone.
